title: 2026-2027学年度第一学期期中考试 八年级英语学科试卷

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 A
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从每道题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
There are many famous places of interest in our country. If you don't know where to travel during the holiday, the following may help you.

**Welcome to Huangguoshu Waterfall (瀑布).**
It is in Anshun, Guizhou. The waterfall looks great. It is like a wonderful picture.
- Opening hours: 7:30~18:00
- Tickets: ¥160 (March 1 - November 30); ¥150 (December 1-February 28); half price for students: free for people over 60

**Stone Forest in Kunming, Yunnan.**
It is about 78 kilometers away from the capital city of Yunnan.
The stones look very beautiful. They look like young girls, funny animals, plants and so on. You shouldn't miss the wonderful place.
- Opening hours: 7:30~17:30
- Ticket: ¥130

**Lijiang River is in Guilin, Guangxi.**
The mountains and water in Guilin are famous around China. Visitors can take a boat to enjoy the beauty.
- Opening hours: 8:30~17:00
- Tickets: ¥210 for adults(成人): half price for children aged from 11 to 14: free for kids under 11 years old

**Jiuzhaigou is in Sichuan.**
It is very beautiful. You may not enjoy water in other places after coming back from Jiuzhaigou.
- Opening hours: 8:00~18:00
- Tickets: ¥190 (April 1 - November 15): ¥80 (November 16-March 31)

questions.prompt: 21. Where can you visit Stone Forest?
questions.translation: 你在哪里可以参观石林？
questions.explanation: 细节理解题。根据文中“Stone Forest in Kunming, Yunnan.”可知，石林在云南昆明。故选 'In Yunnan.'。

questions.prompt: 22. How long does Lijiang River open a day?
questions.translation: 漓江每天开放多长时间？
questions.explanation: 数字计算题。根据文中“Lijiang River is in Guilin, Guangxi. ... Opening hours: 8:30~17:00”可知，从8:30到17:00共8.5小时。故选 '8.5 hours.'。

questions.prompt: 23. What may be the most beautiful in Jiuzhaigou?
questions.translation: 九寨沟最美的可能是什么？
questions.explanation: 细节理解题。根据文中“You may not enjoy water in other places after coming back from Jiuzhaigou.”（九寨沟归来不看水）可知，九寨沟的水最美。故选 'Water.'。

questions.prompt: 24. Where is the passage probably from?
questions.translation: 这篇文章可能来自哪里？
questions.explanation: 推理判断题。文章介绍了中国的四个著名景点及其开放时间和票价，旨在为假期旅游提供参考，因此最可能来自旅游指南。故选 'A travel guidebook.'。

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 B
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从每道题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
I have a lot of friends. My best friend is Meimei. She is 16 years old. She is 2 years older than me. We live in the same town and we began to know each other when we were very young. Now we are classmates. Meimei is taller than me and she has long black hair. She has an oval (椭圆的) face with big eyes, a high nose and a small mouth. Meimei is helpful. When her friends have difficulties, she always tries her best to help them. Meimei is one of the best students in our class. I like studying with her. She always helps me with my studies.

Although we have the same hobbies and interests, we also have some differences. I am <u>sociable</u> and enjoy telling jokes. Meimei, however, is serious and quiet. We believe in each other, so we are good friends. I hope we can keep our friendship forever.

questions.prompt: 25. What does the underlined word "sociable" in Paragraph 2 mean in Chinese?
questions.translation: 第二段中划线词“sociable”的中文意思是什么？
questions.explanation: 词义猜测题。根据下文“and enjoy telling jokes. Meimei, however, is serious and quiet.”可知，作者与严肃安静的梅梅相反，喜欢讲笑话，性格外向、爱交际。故选 '爱交际的'。

questions.prompt: 26. How old is the writer?
questions.translation: 作者多大了？
questions.explanation: 数字计算题。根据文中“She is 16 years old. She is 2 years older than me.”可知，梅梅16岁，比作者大2岁，因此作者14岁。故选 '14'。

questions.prompt: 27. What does the writer think of Meimei?
questions.translation: 作者认为梅梅怎么样？
questions.explanation: 推理判断题。文中提到梅梅乐于助人、学习优秀且总是帮助作者学习，说明作者认为梅梅是个好女孩。故选 'She is a nice girl.'。

questions.prompt: 28. Which of the following is TRUE?
options: Meimei is outgoing and likes talking.
Meimei and the writer are in the same class.
Meimei has a big and round face.
questions.translation: 下列哪项是正确的？
questions.explanation: 细节理解题。根据文中“Now we are classmates.”可知，梅梅和作者在同一个班。故选 'Meimei and the writer are in the same class.'。

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 C
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从每道题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Home is not just a house where we live. It is special and magical.

At home, we build our dreams. We can think about what we are going to be. Maybe we want to be a teacher or a doctor. We can study and learn at home. We can read books and draw pictures. We can talk to our family about our dreams. Home is where our dreams start.

We feel comfortable at home. We can feel love and warmth. We can be ourselves and say everything freely. We feel accepted and helped there.

At home, we learn to listen, care and share. When we have a box of delicious cookies, we share them with our family members. We give some to our brother or sister and see the smiles on their faces. When someone in the family doesn't feel well, we learn to care. We bring him or her a glass of water. When our parents talk about their day, we learn to listen carefully.

Home is also a place of growing. It's where we take our first steps and say our first word. It's where we have our first experiences and make our first memories. Home is where we find our interests. We are not afraid to try anything in this place.

As we grow older, home becomes a refuge (避难所) from the stress of the world. We always find peace there.

questions.prompt: 29. What can we do at home according to the text?
options: Become a teacher or a doctor.
Talk about our dreams with parents.
questions.translation: 根据文章，我们在家可以做什么？
questions.explanation: 细节理解题。根据第二段“We can talk to our family about our dreams.”可知，我们可以在家和家人谈论梦想。故选 'Talk about our dreams with parents.'。

questions.prompt: 30. Why does the writer say we can be ourselves at home?
options: Because sometimes there is no one at home.
Because we have to work hard when we go out.
Because we can say what we want to say freely.
Because home is a place to hide our true feelings.
questions.translation: 为什么作者说我们在家可以做自己？
questions.explanation: 细节理解题。根据第三段“We can be ourselves and say everything freely.”可知，在家可以做自己是因为可以自由地表达一切。故选 'Because we can say what we want to say freely.'。

questions.prompt: 31. What can we learn at home according to the text?
questions.translation: 根据文章，我们在家能学到什么？
questions.explanation: 细节理解题。根据第四段首句“At home, we learn to listen, care and share.”可知，我们在家学会倾听、关心和分享。故选 'To listen, care and share.'。

questions.prompt: 32. Where do we begin our life according to the text?
questions.translation: 根据文章，我们在哪里开始我们的生活？
questions.explanation: 细节理解题。根据第五段“It's where we take our first steps and say our first word. It's where we have our first experiences and make our first memories.”可知，家是我们迈出第一步、说出第一句话、开始生活的地方。故选 'At home.'。

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 D
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从每道题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Bamboo is one of the nature's most surprising plants. It is a kind of grass, though many people call it a tree.

Like other kinds of grass although you cut it very low to the ground, it will grow back very quickly. A Japanese scientist recorded that one bamboo plant grew nearly 1.5 meters in 24 hours. Bamboo grows almost everywhere in the world except Europe. There are over 1,000 kinds of bamboo and they grow around the world on both mountains and plains (平原).

Not all bamboo looks the same. Some bamboo plants are thick (粗的). They may grow to more than 30 centimeters wide while others may only grow to be a few centimeters wide. They may also have different colors, like yellow, black and green.

Bamboo is a kind of <u>utility</u> plant. Many Asian countries use it to make many things such as hats and kitchen tools. And it is used to build buildings or support new buildings and bridges. In fact, the cables (缆索) that hold up the hanging bridge (悬索桥) across the Min River in Sichuan are made of bamboo.

In Africa, engineers (工程师) are teaching poor farmers how to carry water by using bamboo. These farmers need cheap ways because they have no money. Bamboo pipes (管子) can help them bring water to their thirsty fields without much money.

questions.prompt: 33. How is bamboo like grass according to the passage?
options: It is thin and easy to cut.
It grows quickly after it's cut short.
questions.translation: 根据文章，竹子在哪些方面像草？
questions.explanation: 细节理解题。根据第二段“Like other kinds of grass although you cut it very low to the ground, it will grow back very quickly.”可知，竹子像其他草一样，即使割得很低也会很快长回来。故选 'It grows quickly after it's cut short.'。

questions.prompt: 34. We can infer (推断) from Paragraph 2 that ______.
options: a bamboo plant may grow 4.5 meters in three days
the Japanese scientist is good at growing bamboo plants
bamboo is able to grow well in any part of the world
mountains are the best places for the bamboo to grow
questions.translation: 我们可以从第二段推断出什么？
questions.explanation: 推理判断题。根据第二段“one bamboo plant grew nearly 1.5 meters in 24 hours”可知，一棵竹子一天（24小时）能长近1.5米，由此可推断三天可能长4.5米。故选 'a bamboo plant may grow 4.5 meters in three days'。

questions.prompt: 35. The underlined word "utility" in Paragraph 4 probably means ______.
questions.translation: 第四段中划线词“utility”的意思可能是？
questions.explanation: 词义猜测题。第四段接着举例说明竹子被用来制作帽子、厨房用具、建造房屋和支撑桥梁等，说明竹子是一种非常有用的植物。故选 'useful'。

questions.prompt: 36. Why do the engineers teach the poor farmers in Africa to use bamboo?
options: Because it is used by Asians.
questions.translation: 为什么工程师们教非洲的贫困农民使用竹子？
questions.explanation: 细节理解题。根据最后一段“These farmers need cheap ways because they have no money. Bamboo pipes (管子) can help them bring water to their thirsty fields without much money.”可知，因为竹子便宜。故选 'Because it is cheap.'。

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 第二节 (阅读还原)
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从方框内所给的选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项，其中有一个多余的选项。
sections.passage:
Parents usually don't let their children cook. They think it's dangerous for children to do it. However, scientists say that it's good for children to do some easy cooking work, such as doing the dishes and washing vegetables.

**Cooking makes children smart.**
In some cooking activities, children can choose and decide what things to put in a dish or how much salt to put in a dish. [1] At the same time, they can learn how to serve their friends by cooking themselves. They can also learn to eat healthily.

**Cooking teaches children to feel how things change.**
When helping cook in the kitchen, children can touch some different ingredients (食材) and they can also see how food changes by temperature. [2]

**Cooking makes children confident.**
When children learn to cook, they usually feel that they have grown up, and they can do something for their family members. [3] So cooking is well worth (值得) learning.

**Cooking teaches children cultures.**
[4] When cooking different kinds of food, children can also learn about different cultures. Also children can learn some traditional eating cultures by cooking.
wordbank: So it's good for them to get life experience.
Cooking can help children grow up.
That's a great way to make them think actively.
Children can cook a great dinner to show their love.
Cooking in one culture is quite different from that in another.

questions.translation: 37. 那是让他们积极思考的好方法。
questions.explanation: 本段小标题为“Cooking makes children smart.”，前句提到孩子可以选择和决定放什么食材和多少盐，这能促使他们积极思考。故选 'That's a great way to make them think actively.'。

questions.translation: 38. 所以这对他们获得生活经验很有好处。
questions.explanation: 前句提到孩子在厨房帮忙时可以触摸不同食材并观察食物随温度的变化，这是很好的生活体验。故选 'So it's good for them to get life experience.'。

questions.translation: 39. 孩子们可以做一顿丰盛的晚餐来表达他们的爱。
questions.explanation: 前句提到孩子学会做饭后会觉得自己长大了，能为家人做些事情，紧接着说明他们可以做一顿丰盛的晚餐来表达对家人的爱。故选 'Children can cook a great dinner to show their love.'。

questions.translation: 40. 一种文化中的烹饪与另一种文化中的烹饪大不相同。
questions.explanation: 本段小标题为“Cooking teaches children cultures.”，空后提到烹饪不同食物能了解不同文化，因此此处应引出不同文化中烹饪的差异。故选 'Cooking in one culture is quite different from that in another.'。

sections.title: 二、完形填空
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，理解其大意，从A、B、C、D四个选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Do you know how to help your friends by talking with them? Here are some suggestions for you.

First, tell your friends if you're worried about them. For example, you might say something like, "John, I've noticed that you [1] coming to game nights and that you are [2] most of your time alone. I'm worried about you."

Second, let your friends know that you will be there for them [3] they need your help. Try saying something like, "I will be here [4] you if you ever want to talk." or "Let me know if there's [5] I can do to help."

Third, listen to your friends if they want to talk with you. Give your friends your [6] if they want to talk, such as by putting away your phone and [7] the TV or your computer. Face them and make [8] contact (接触) with them. While your friends are talking, listen to what they say [9] and nod to show you are listening to them.

Fourth, tell your friends a story if something [10] happened to you. If you have had such an experience, sharing it with them might help them to feel better because they think you can understand them.

questions.translation: 41. 我注意到你不再来参加游戏之夜了。
questions.explanation: 根据下文“most of your time alone. I'm worried about you.”可知，John不再来参加游戏之夜了，stop doing sth.表示“停止做某事”。故选 'stopped'。

questions.translation: 42. 而且你大部分时间都是一个人度过的。
questions.explanation: spend time alone表示“独自度过时间”，主语是人，用spending。故选 'spending'。

questions.translation: 43. 如果他们需要你的帮助，让你的朋友知道你会在他们身边。
questions.explanation: 此处表示条件，“如果他们需要你的帮助”，应用if引导条件状语从句。故选 'if'。

questions.translation: 44. 如果你想聊聊，我随时都在这里支持你。
questions.explanation: be here for sb.是固定搭配，意为“在某人身边支持某人”。故选 'for'。

questions.translation: 45. 如果有什么我能帮忙的，请告诉我。
questions.explanation: 在if引导的条件句中表示“任何事情”应用anything。故选 'anything'。

questions.translation: 46. 如果你的朋友想倾诉，给他们你的时间。
questions.explanation: 根据下文“putting away your phone...”可知，要放下手机专心陪伴，即把时间留给朋友。故选 'time'。

questions.translation: 47. 比如收起你的手机，关掉电视或电脑。
questions.explanation: 为了专心倾听朋友说话，应该关掉电视或电脑。turn off意为“关掉”。故选 'turning off'。

questions.translation: 48. 面对他们，并与他们进行眼神交流。
questions.explanation: make eye contact是固定短语，意为“进行眼神交流”。故选 'eye'。

questions.translation: 49. 当你的朋友说话时，认真听他们说什么并点头表示你在听。
questions.explanation: 倾听朋友时应该“认真地”听，carefully意为“认真地、仔细地”。故选 'carefully'。

questions.translation: 50. 如果你身上发生过类似的事情，给你的朋友讲一个故事。
questions.explanation: 根据下文“If you have had such an experience, sharing it with them might help them to feel better”可知，是指“类似的”经历。故选 'similar'。

sections.title: 三、语篇填空
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，在空白处填入一个适当的单词或用括号内所给词的正确形式填空，使短文通顺、连贯。
sections.passage:
In life people need to relax after work. People can't work all the time because they need to be in good [1] (healthy) and enjoy life.

There are different ways of [2] (relax). And lots of people think they can feel relaxed [3] playing sports. There are team sports, such as basketball [4] football. There are also sports like swimming and running. They are not team sports. When you play [5] (this) sports, you don't need to play together with others. Some people love to climb [6] (mountain) or go boating on the lake to relax. Why? Because they like to play sports outside.

Not all people enjoy playing sports to relax outside. Some like playing sports in rooms. They love to run on a treadmill (跑步机) or swim in a pool inside. However, there [7] (be) such people around us. They don't like to play sports to relax. They just want [8] (stay) at home. They watch sports news on TV or watch online sports games on [9] sofa.

Although people are interested in [10] (difference) ways, all of these ways can help them relax. They are good for the mind and the body.

questions.translation: 51. 人们不能一直工作，因为他们需要保持良好的健康并享受生活。
questions.explanation: be in good health是固定短语，意为“身体健康”，此处需用名词health。故选 'health'。

questions.translation: 52. 有不同的放松方式。
questions.explanation: 介词of后接动词的-ing形式，relax的动名词为relaxing。故选 'relaxing'。

questions.translation: 53. 很多人认为他们可以通过做运动来感到放松。
questions.explanation: by doing sth.表示“通过做某事”，符合句意。故选 'by'。

questions.translation: 54. 有团队运动，比如篮球和足球。
questions.explanation: basketball和football为并列关系，在肯定句中用and连接。故选 'and'。

questions.translation: 55. 当你做这些运动时，你不需要和别人一起玩。
questions.explanation: 空后sports为复数名词，this的复数形式为these。故选 'these'。

questions.translation: 56. 有些人喜欢爬山或在湖上划船来放松。
questions.explanation: climb mountains表示“爬山”，mountain为可数名词，此处用复数形式表示泛指。故选 'mountains'。

questions.translation: 57. 然而，我们身边也有这样的人。
questions.explanation: there be句型遵循就近原则，主语such people为复数，且全文为一般现在时，故用are。故选 'are'。

questions.translation: 58. 他们只想待在家里。
questions.explanation: want to do sth.是固定搭配，意为“想要做某事”。故选 'to stay'。

questions.translation: 59. 他们在电视上看体育新闻，或者在沙发上看网络体育比赛。
questions.explanation: on the sofa是固定搭配，意为“在沙发上”。故选 'the'。

questions.translation: 60. 虽然人们对不同的方式感兴趣，但所有这些方式都能帮助他们放松。
questions.explanation: 空后ways为名词，需用形容词修饰，difference的形容词形式为different。故选 'different'。

sections.title: 四、阅读与表达
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，然后根据内容回答问题。
sections.passage:
It's difficult when you have no good friends around maybe because you move to a different school or a different class or you're sick at home. You may feel lonely without friends. You want to have new friends. But how to make them? How do you start? How do you get along with people? Here are some ways to help you do these.

**Greet people**
Greet people and hope that they have a good day at any time of the day. It doesn't hurt (伤害) any people. It also makes people think you're friendly.

**Share**
Take something to eat in your bag. Ask if people would like to have some, and at the same time give it to them.

**Help people**
Simple actions, like helping other people carry something or opening a door can show your kindness.

**Smile**
Perhaps smiling is the easiest way to introduce (介绍) yourself. There's a great reason why we smile. It takes fewer muscles (肌肉) to smile than to cry. Nature just wishes us to smile more.

**Respect (尊敬) others**
The world is full of differences. So learning to respect others is important. It is the only way that other people will respect you.

questions.prompt: 61. How may you feel without a friend?
questions.translation: 没有朋友你可能会有什么感觉？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“You may feel lonely without friends.”可知，没有朋友可能会感到孤独。故选 'Lonely.'。

questions.prompt: 62. How many ways does the article give us to help us make new friends?
questions.translation: 文章给了我们多少种交新朋友的方法？
questions.explanation: 文章列出了五个小标题：Greet people, Share, Help people, Smile, Respect others，共5种方法。故选 'Five.'。

questions.prompt: 63. What does the writer advise (建议) us to take in our bag?
questions.translation: 作者建议我们在包里带什么？
questions.explanation: 根据Share部分“Take something to eat in your bag.”可知，作者建议在包里带些吃的东西。故选 'Something to eat.'。

questions.prompt: 64. How do you often make friends? Write 30 words or more.
options: I often make friends by being friendly and helpful. First, I always smile and greet my classmates warmly. Second, I like sharing my snacks and interesting books with them. Also, I listen carefully when they talk and help them whenever they are in trouble.
I never talk to anyone at school because I prefer to stay alone all the time.
I only make friends with people who give me expensive gifts every day.
Making friends is too difficult for me, so I just play computer games at home.
questions.translation: 你经常如何交朋友？写30词或以上。
questions.explanation: 开放性问题，需结合积极交友的方式作答且字数不少于30词。第一项积极正面且字数达标。故选 'I often make friends by being friendly and helpful. First, I always smile and greet my classmates warmly. Second, I like sharing my snacks and interesting books with them. Also, I listen carefully when they talk and help them whenever they are in trouble.'。
